summary: Feed s131_double is degraded: 20.5% duplicate packets and 14.0% truncated/sliced frames (to 128B). Duplicates waste NDR capacity and distort detection; slicing removes payload this NDR requires for full inspection.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is forwarding the same packets twice without deduplication - typical when aggregating multiple SPAN/mirror sessions or dual TAP feeds covering the same link and merging them to one tool port without dedup enabled.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR wastes CPU/storage processing 798 duplicate packets (20.5%), inflates flow/connection counts, skews analytics and can cause missed detections due to state-table bloat and false correlation.

recommended_fix.why: Enable packet-broker deduplication (hash-based, ~10ms window) upstream of the NDR to deliver one copy of each packet while preserving both directions.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker slicing/packet truncation is enabled and cutting frames to ~128 bytes snaplen to save bandwidth, but this NDR profile needs_full_payload=true.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR cannot perform deep-packet inspection or payload-based threat detection on 543 frames (14.0%); signatures, exploit and malware detection will fail on sliced traffic.

recommended_fix.why: Disable slicing for this NDR feed and forward full frames up to the tool's 9216B MTU so the NDR receives complete L4+ payload for analysis.
